key: CORAL SHUTTER UNLOCKED
en: CORAL SHUTTER UNLOCKED
ja: コーラルシャッター解除

key: TITANIA: Hmph.
en: TITANIA: Hmph.
ja: ティタニア: フン。

key: \PN, you remember I only have one Pokémon with me, right?
en: \PN, you remember I only have one Pokémon with me, right?
ja: \PN、あたしがポケモンを一匹しか連れてないの、覚えてるわよね?

key: TITANIA: I'll back you up, but you're gonna have to pull the weight here.
en: TITANIA: I'll back you up, but you're gonna have to pull the weight here.
ja: ティタニア: サポートはするけど、ここはあんたが頑張らないと。

key: Loyalty to Team Meteor is the only way to replenish this world.
en: Loyalty to Team Meteor is the only way to replenish this world.
ja: この世界を　満たす道は　メテオ団への　忠誠　ただひとつ

key: How foolish of you.
en: How foolish of you.
ja: ウェス: 愚かなことだ。

key: TITANIA: Now you're defenseless, so get out of our way.
en: TITANIA: Now you're defenseless, so get out of our way.
ja: ティタニア: これで丸腰ね、さっさとどきなさい。

key: TAKA: You know, battles are one thing, but I don't particularly appreciate you harming my colleagues.
en: TAKA: You know, battles are one thing, but I don't particularly appreciate you harming my colleagues.
ja: タカ: バトルはまだしも、僕の仲間を傷つけるのはあんまり感心しないな。

key: TITANIA: And I don't particularly appreciate you taking my friend.
en: TITANIA: And I don't particularly appreciate you taking my friend.
ja: ティタニア: あたしも、あんたが友達をさらったことに、あんまり感心してないけど。

key: Team Meteor will stop at nothing to achieve their goals.
en: Team Meteor will stop at nothing to achieve their goals.
ja: チームメテオは目的のためなら手段を選ばないんでしょ。

key: So why should I?
en: So why should I?
ja: なら、あたしが選ぶ必要もないでしょ。

key: TAKA: Look, I really can't defend some of the others' actions, all right?
en: TAKA: Look, I really can't defend some of the others' actions, all right?
ja: タカ: あのさ、他の連中のやったことを僕が全部弁護できるわけじゃないんだ、分かるだろ?

key: But do you see these guys hurting anyone?
en: But do you see these guys hurting anyone?
ja: でも、こいつらが誰かを傷つけてるように見える?

key: Do you see me killing anyone?
en: Do you see me killing anyone?
ja: 僕が誰かを殺してるように見える?

key: TITANIA: Release Amaria and then try that argument.
en: TITANIA: Release Amaria and then try that argument.
ja: ティタニア: アマリアを解放してから、その理屈を言いなさい。

key: TAKA: Yeaaah, I don't think that's gonna work out.
en: TAKA: Yeaaah, I don't think that's gonna work out.
ja: タカ: いやぁ、それはちょっと無理そうだね。

key: But hey, she's in the Control Room if you wanna come and get her.
en: But hey, she's in the Control Room if you wanna come and get her.
ja: でもまあ、迎えに来たいなら、彼女は管理室にいるよ。

key: TITANIA: Believe me, I intend to.
en: TITANIA: Believe me, I intend to.
ja: ティタニア: もちろん、そのつもりよ。

key: TAKA: Now, now. Not so fast.
en: TAKA: Now, now. Not so fast.
ja: タカ: まあまあ、そう急がないで。

key: I-- I nearly--
en: I-- I nearly--
ja: ぼ――僕、もう少しで――

key: Bless Arceus for my life now...
en: Bless Arceus for my life now...
ja: 今、こうして生きていられるのはアルセウスのおかげ……

key: TITANIA: This is getting annoying... I think I overdid it.
en: TITANIA: This is getting annoying... I think I overdid it.
ja: ティタニア: 面倒になってきたわね……ちょっとやりすぎたかも。

key: I'm gonna rest a minute. I'll catch up to you.
en: I'm gonna rest a minute. I'll catch up to you.
ja: ちょっと休むから。後で追いつくわ。

key: TITANIA: I'm gonna rest a minute. Go on ahead, and I'll catch up to you.
en: TITANIA: I'm gonna rest a minute. Go on ahead, and I'll catch up to you.
ja: ティタニア: ちょっと休むわ。先に行ってて、あとで追いつくから。

key: It should've been me...
en: It should've been me...
ja: あたしのはずだったのに……
